# Migration to the Text 0.4.2 candidate

The seven capability IDs and the directory profile are unchanged. SQL accepts optional dialect, indent and keywordCase. A text-only request produces the former generic, four-space, uppercase result. The other capabilities retain their text-only schemas. The SQL response still contains text. The packaged Text View continues to use the generic defaults. The prior 0.4.1 directory remains available. This unsigned candidate requires separate Studio install and lifecycle acceptance.
